title: Jude and the Veil
author: Tamsin Reyes
blurb: Dominic Thornbury, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
